content: Formspree is the most established forms-as-a-backend service with a first-party React SDK (@formspree/react) and works with plain HTML/JS forms on static hosts; paid tier ~/mo for 200 submissions/month, spam protection costs extra on some tiers. Resend is a transactional email API (not a form backend) — requires you to write your own submit handler (e.g. a Vercel/Netlify serverless function) that calls the Resend API; more setup but no per-submission form-service markup and pairs well if already deploying to Vercel/Netlify (both support serverless functions natively). EmailJS sends email directly from client-side JS using a connected email provider account; simplest to wire but exposes provider connection to client bundle and has stricter free-tier limits.
